archive_path.description: Optional: a resume archive (.json under ~/.synaps-cli/subagent-history/) of a worker from an earlier or crashed session. handle_id is then only a label.

context_rollover.description: Optional. "off" runs this worker without context rollover; "inherit" (the default) follows this session's context management.

full_history.description: Optional (default false): replay the worker's full conversation even when its prompt cache has expired. Otherwise a cold history above subagent_cold_resume_compact_tokens is resumed from a compact context (original task, last steps, final report), avoiding a full cache rewrite. A worker that inherits the session's context management always replays in full (it rolls over instead).

handle_id.description: Handle ID of the completed subagent to resume (e.g. "sa_3").

instructions.description: What to do next. Sent as the next user turn after the worker's own prior conversation.

thinking.description: Override worker effort for this resumed run. Omit to keep its recorded effort; legacy archives use subagent_thinking (default xhigh). Unsupported model levels are refused.

timeout.description: Optional wall-clock limit in seconds for the resumed run (default: the prior run's); 0 = no limit. Positive values below 300s emit a warning; prefer at least 600s for API retries.
